messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] how to use GetUnitIntensities from a subset of arrays...
parts:
Use extract():

# get intensities for first unit for first 5 arrays
myIntensities <- getUnitIntensities(extract(csN, 1:5), units=1, stratifyBy="pm")
